title: Available: 2 different AW smartwatches to donate to a developer willing to work on "Force collector" problems
symptom: The user reports that neither the Fossil Q Founder 2.0 nor the Polar M600 smartwatch could be made to work in 'Force Collector' mode in the latest alpha channel release of xDrip+, and they are offering the watches to a developer to investigate why the force collector option does not work on watches other than the Smartwatch 3.
fix: The thread indicates that a firmware patch was produced for the Zenwatch 2 and later the Polar M600 and Asus Zenwatch3 were supported, but no specific fix for the reported watches is stated.
evidence_quote: I could not get either watch to work under force collector mode in the latest alpha channel release of xdrip+.
